description: This file implements a thread-safe map and associated methods for managing waiting pods during scheduling permit phase in Kubernetes scheduler framework.

classes.name: waitingPodsMap
classes.description: A thread-safe map for managing waitingPod instances keyed by pod UID.

classes.name: waitingPod
classes.description: Represents a pod waiting during the permit phase, with methods to allow, reject, or preempt the pod.

methods.name: NewWaitingPodsMap
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of waitingPodsMap.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a waitingPod to the map.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a waitingPod from the map by UID.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a waitingPod from the map by UID.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Iterates over all waitingPods, executing a callback.

methods.name: GetPod
methods.description: Returns the pod associated with the waitingPod.

methods.name: GetPendingPlugins
methods.description: Returns a list of plugin names that are pending for the waitingPod.

methods.name: Allow
methods.description: Marks the waitingPod as allowed to be scheduled if all plugins permit.

methods.name: Reject
methods.description: Marks the waitingPod as unschedulable with a message.

methods.name: Preempt
methods.description: Marks the waitingPod as preempted with a message.

methods.name: stopWithStatus
methods.description: Stops all timers and sets the status of the waitingPod with a given code, plugin, and message.
